rhythm: Songsterr s52262 (revision 8980643), 130 BPM, 4/4. The opening one-beat guitar slap is restored at beat 0; the ocarina rests for that beat, then Rodrigo's lead guitar track (G1), Songsterr bars 2-33, plays the sixteenth riff (bars 2-17) then the melody (bars 18-33). 129 beats = 59.5 s. Rests under half a beat folded into the note before; the four sixteenth triplets (bars 19, 23, 27, 31) cut to their first two notes as sixteenths so every bar keeps its length (HmWhyNot's call). Shifted -2 (D4..G5 -> C4..F5, 182 modifiers against 190 at -3). The sixteenths are shorter than the ocarina's 0.08 s minimum at 130 BPM, so the stream slows the whole song to about 110 BPM (kept on purpose). Not checked against a second source. Drums: only the percussive hits already in the tab's Drums and Woodblock tracks (same positions): the opening dead-note slap as snare, dead-note chord slaps as snare, low-string thumps as kick, dynamics from the tab. Bass: the second guitar's walking line (G3, bars 26-33) an octave up, finger bass. Part: Gabriela's full rhythm-guitar track (G2), including all fast subdivisions and muted strums, represented as short nylon-guitar notes so the strumming backbone stays present. Band moved by the same -2.
